# Easebar
> Easebar provides AI-powered customer support and help center tools for ecommerce brands.

Easebar focuses on automating customer service workflows, self-service support, and AI assistance for online stores, with product information centered on platform capabilities, integrations, and support operations.

## Product
- [Easebar Home](https://easebar.com/): Overview of the platform for AI customer support and ecommerce help center automation.
- [AI Customer Service](https://easebar.com/ai-customer-service): Product page describing AI-driven support automation for ecommerce teams.
- [Help Center](https://easebar.com/help-center): Overview of self-service help center capabilities for customer support.
- [Live Chat](https://easebar.com/live-chat): Information about live chat support features for ecommerce stores.
- [Order Tracking](https://easebar.com/order-tracking): Product details for customer-facing order tracking and support workflows.
- [Returns Management](https://easebar.com/returns-management): Overview of returns-related support automation and customer service tools.

## Solutions
- [Ecommerce Customer Support](https://easebar.com/ecommerce-customer-support): Solution page for support automation tailored to ecommerce businesses.
- [Shopify Customer Support](https://easebar.com/shopify-customer-support): Information about support workflows and automation for Shopify merchants.
- [Customer Service Automation](https://easebar.com/customer-service-automation): Overview of automating repetitive support tasks with AI.
- [Self-Service Support](https://easebar.com/self-service-support): Details on enabling customers to resolve issues through self-service resources.
- [Support Ticket Management](https://easebar.com/support-ticket-management): Information about organizing and handling customer support requests.

## Integrations
- [Shopify Integration](https://easebar.com/integrations/shopify): Details on connecting Easebar with Shopify stores and workflows.
- [Gorgias Integration](https://easebar.com/integrations/gorgias): Information about integrating Easebar with Gorgias support operations.
- [Zendesk Integration](https://easebar.com/integrations/zendesk): Overview of Zendesk connectivity for customer support teams.
- [Klaviyo Integration](https://easebar.com/integrations/klaviyo): Details on linking customer communication and marketing workflows.
- [Recharge Integration](https://easebar.com/integrations/recharge): Information about subscription-related support integration for ecommerce brands.
